title: 8 Things a Godly Man's Phone Habits Actually Confess About Him
caption:
Screen time doesn't lie.

The app you open first without deciding to. Who you compare your life to before you've prayed today. What you type into search at 1 AM that you'd never say out loud. How many times you check it during the hour you promised someone your full attention.

Psalm 139 says He already searched you and knows you. The question is whether you've let Him past the lock screen too.

#faith #christianmen #manofgod #phone #digitalminimalism
